acceptanceCriteria: The receipts pin only the clauses they depend on, or a recorded decision keeps the whole-spec pin.
Editing an unrelated DCW section does not require a receipt repin, with a test.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. conformance/use-cases-v0/receipts/{UC-TASK-ORIENTATION,UC-EVIDENCE-CARRYING-COMPLETION,UC-CHANGE-CONSEQUENCE}/contract.json pin the digest of all of docs/specs/daily-change-evidence-workflow-v0.md. Any PR that edits the DCW spec must repin all three receipts, and concurrent DCW PRs re-repin after each merge (seen with V1-0142, V1-0173 and PRs #130, #133, #143).
title: conformance: use-case contract receipts pin the whole DCW spec digest, so every DCW edit forces repins
